newsitem.title: FRANCE: France expels Romanian, Cape Verdian immigrants.
newsitem.headline: France expels Romanian, Cape Verdian immigrants.

text.p: France expelled on Thursday 38 Romanians and six citizens of the Cape Verde islands who lacked residency papers, the Interior Ministry announced on Thursday.
The Romanians were flown home to Bucharest on a charter aircraft while the Cape Verdians were taken home on scheduled flights, the ministry said in a statement.
France has deported 17,706 illgeal immigrants since May 1995 when President Jacques Chirac took office, the statement said.
This year's expulsions are running 18 percent ahead of the 1995 pace, it said.

Illegal immigration is a hot issue in France, where unemployment rose to a record 12.6 percent in August and the extreme-right National Front has gained strength in recent elections on a pledge to eject millions of immigrants including even legal residents.
